text:
alex.k: quick question — i'm about to add an optional "context" object under function_call in the messages schema. goal: let tool adapters get hints (tenant_id, request_id) without changing args. will this be compatible with older SDKs that validate shape strictly?

maria.p: in general optional nested fields are ok, but a lot of our older client libs run basic shape validation. we should either: 1) mark as optional + nullable in docs, or 2) ship a minor sdk bump that tolerates extra fields. prefer 1 + compat note.

chen.li: +1. streaming detail: how do we surface context during delta streaming? current pattern: deltas are incremental tokens or small objects like {"delta": {"function_call": {"name":"foo"}}} then final chunk has `args`. if we include context, do we emit it in the first function_call delta or only in the final chunk?

alex.k: good call. i think emitting context in the first function_call delta makes sense so adapters get it early. downside: older clients might drop unexpected nested keys in deltas. thoughts?

sam.dev: i'd prefer first-delta approach for adapter routing latency. can we add a header "x-schema-version: 2" for streaming so clients can opt-in? then we can gate docs and SDKs. :thinking_face: 

maria.p: header sounds heavy. alternate: include a small top-level `meta` delta in the stream, e.g. `{"delta":{"meta":{"context":...}}}` before function_call deltas. that keeps function_call shape unchanged.

chen.li: oh nice — meta delta is non-breaking for parsers that ignore unknown top-level keys. also lets us extend later without touching function_call. implementors: will runtime produce meta only when non-empty?

alex.k: yes — runtime will emit meta delta only when context present. example (stream chunks):

```json
{ "delta": { "meta": { "context": { "tenant": "acme", "request_id": "r-123" } } } }
{ "delta": { "function_call": { "name": "lookup_pr", "arguments": "{\"pr\":123}\n" } } }
{ "delta": { "finish_reason": "function_call" } }
```

sam.dev: sounds good. can we add a small integration test that verifies old parser ignores meta delta? i'll add a test in the sdk repo.

maria.p: i'll update the API docs and add a compat note + example streams. alex, can you open a tiny RFC and a PR to the runtime? tag me for review.

alex.k: will do — filing RFC now and will link PR. infra-bot: feature-flag:create done on staging. :rocket:

infra-bot: staging rollout scheduled for 2025-09-18 03:00 UTC, flag: stream_meta_context

sam.dev: perfect — i'll queue sdk test and ping when green.

maria.p: thanks everyone. keeping this async was perfect. :+1:
